spec.body_markdown:
## Absolute Error

Absolute error is the plain difference between a measured value and the true (accepted) value, always taken as a positive quantity.

Delta x = |x_true - x_measured|

- It carries the same units as the measurement itself (cm, kg, s, etc.).
- It does not tell you whether the error is significant relative to the size of the measurement — that's what relative error is for.
- Example: true length 100 cm, measured 99.5 cm gives an absolute error of 0.5 cm.
